relations: Clay 与 Kayla：Clay 说“I have already done it”（已认领），Kayla 承认“I’m his, and I think I’m okay with that fact”；Clay 要她“Trust your instincts and never doubt yourself”，并声明若有人伤她“I will kill them”，Kayla 划线说“You can’t hurt someone on my behalf”。

Clay 与 Vero / Brawley：Clay 要求 Kayla 对 Vero 和 Brawley 保密（“I need you not to say anything to Vero or Brawley tonight”），理由是“Vero has just come out of an episode”、且“Brawley can’t keep a fucking secret to save his life when it comes to Vero”。
Clay 与家人：Clay 有两个妹妹 Jess 和 Meeka（“I know you have two sisters”“My other sister’s name is Meeka”），Meeka 比 Jess 大、比 Clay 小；父亲独自带大三个孩子，母亲已去世，Clay 从小“I took on the parent role”。
Clay 与两个妹妹的差别：Jess 更鲁莽（“she doesn’t think before she acts”）且知道 Clay 夜里的差事（“my kinky little night chases”），Meeka 更谨慎但更不吭声（“she isn’t as vocal as Jess if she has a problem”），Clay 最担心的是 Meeka 那种沉默。

Kayla 与 Aaron：分手近三年仍被其影响（“It’s been three years almost to the day that I left Aaron, yet he still gets inside my head”）；Kayla 与楼下 Mabel 则是她“never wanted but the universe granted me”的祖母式存在，Mabel 夜里一直等到她回家。
numbers: three years almost to the day
a minute to open the door

facts.fact: Kayla 下班回到自己的 loft，察觉有人来过——她记得没关的窗现在关着、浴室门开着，但屋里无人也无物动过；她的第一反应是Aaron式联想（“It’s been three years almost to the day that I left Aaron”）。
facts.anchor: but I know someone has been inside my loft.

facts.fact: 她下楼敲 Mabel 的门询问是否有人来过，得到的回答是“No, is everything okay?”，Kayla 只能以“我 just thought I left a window open”收场；Mabel 夜里通常一直等到她回家。
facts.anchor: Sorry to bother you, but has anyone been in my loft today?

facts.fact: 回楼后 Kayla 看到餐桌旁的椅子被推进桌下，“The chair at the table is pushed in perfectly, but I never push it back in.”，由此确认确实有人进过；她放弃打给 Vero（怕他 spiral），改拨 Clay，因为“he is no bullshit”。
facts.anchor: The chair at the table is pushed in perfectly, but I never push it back in.

facts.fact: Clay 赶来把整个 loft 走了一遍，从床下滑出一样东西：“Nothing, just a piece of broken chalk.”；Kayla 因此觉得自己为一把椅子大呼小叫很蠢。
facts.anchor: Nothing, just a piece of broken chalk.

facts.fact: Clay 安排她当晚跟自己去岛上，说要“check the place properly”而现在办不到、“There could be bugs”；Kayla 反驳后他澄清“Not those kinds of bugs—I mean listening devices”，并要她先回去拿设备，同时在车上要求她对 Vero 和 Brawley 保密。
facts.anchor: Not those kinds of bugs—I mean listening devices.

facts.fact: Clay 追问她异常是否与时令有关（“What time of year?”），Kayla 心里恐慌——“It's not that I don’t want to tell him—I can’t”，她只说“I’m not ready.”，Clay 点头不再逼问；本章她始终未说出原因。
在 Clay 房间，Kayla 推开他没关严的浴室门一起洗澡并发生关系，全程“keep my eyes locked on his”；她说“I never expected to feel safe with him, but I do”，并承认“I’m his, and I think I’m okay with that fact.”
facts.anchor: I’m his, and I think I’m okay with that fact.

facts.fact: Kayla 说既然被认领就该更了解他，问出 Clay 有两个妹妹，另一个叫 Meeka、比 Jess 大比 Clay 小；Clay 讲父亲独自带大三个孩子、自己从小当爹，母亲已去世，并说 Jess 叫他“my kinky little night chases”而 Meeka 只知道白天发生的事，他怕她们告诉父亲。
facts.anchor: My other sister’s name is Meeka.
